userStories.title: Block publish when required evidence is missing
userStories.description: As a release owner, I want publish to be blocked deterministically when required evidence artifacts are missing.
acceptanceCriteria: Missing required evidence classes trigger blocking decision
Blocking signal is deterministic and machine-consumable
researchTopics: Current release-check blocking patterns and evidence coverage signals
Deterministic machine-detail formatting for missing evidence contracts
userStories.learnings: Implemented a blocking P0 evidence completeness gate with deterministic missing evidence class output and authoritative no_go/go decision semantics.
userStories.implementationNotes: evidence_completeness_blocker_signal wired into checks as blocking P0; evaluates quality/weekly evidence presence and machine payload availability with deterministic detail ordering.
userStories.notes: Preserve existing checks; add blocker as authoritative publish gate.

userStories.title: Block publish on failed gate score or critical issues
userStories.description: As a release owner, I want deterministic blocking when chapter gate score fails or critical issues remain unresolved.
researchTopics: Existing P0 blocker signals reusable for gate-score/critical-issue enforcement
Deterministic reason-code conventions in release decision payload
userStories.learnings: Gate-score and critical-issue publish blocking should compose from canonical deterministic blockers/reason codes, with no parallel interpretation path.
userStories.implementationNotes: Additive P0 gate-score blocker should reuse chapter_gate_scoring decision semantics and existing conflict/triage blockers to emit machine-readable no_go reasons.
userStories.notes: Avoid parallel blocker semantics; compose from canonical gate outputs.

userStories.title: Persist release-readiness output as traceable artifact
userStories.description: As an auditor, I want release-readiness outputs persisted with deterministic trace metadata for audit replay.
acceptanceCriteria: Release readiness artifact includes deterministic trace metadata
Artifact is discoverable by existing evidence tooling
researchTopics: Existing evidence artifact trace envelope conventions
Release summary output persistence patterns and path stability
userStories.learnings: Release-readiness output is now persisted as a deterministic evidence artifact with canonical trace metadata and stable path contract for audit replay.
userStories.implementationNotes: Persist release-readiness output as additive artifact with stable path contract, canonical trace envelope (`trace_id`, `session_id`, `run_id`, timestamp), and discoverability parity with existing evidence tooling.
userStories.notes: Keep persistence additive and path-contract safe.
